import sys
import math

class Point:
    def __init__(self, a, b, c, d, e):
        self.v = a
        self.w = b
        self.x = c
        self.y = d
        self.z = e
    
    def mag(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.v*self.v + self.w*self.w + self.x*self.x + self.y*self.y + self.z*self.z)

def angle(a, b):
    amag = a.mag()
    bmag = b.mag()
    abmag = a.v * b.v + a.w * b.w + a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z
    angle_deg = math.degrees(math.acos(abmag / (amag * bmag)))
    return angle_deg < 90

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n > 11:
        print("0")
        return
    arr = []
    for _ in range(n):
        a = int(next(it)); b = int(next(it)); c = int(next(it)); d = int(next(it)); e = int(next(it))
        arr.append(Point(a, b, c, d, e))
    
    good = []
    for i in range(n):
        b = True
        for j in range(n):
            for k in range(n):
                if i != j and i != k and j != k:
                    one = arr[j]
                    two = arr[k]
                    three = arr[i]
                    lol2 = Point(one.v - three.v, one.w - three.w, one.x - three.x, one.y - three.y, one.z - three.z)
                    lol1 = Point(two.v - three.v, two.w - three.w, two.x - three.x, two.y - three.y, two.z - three.z)
                    if angle(lol1, lol2):
                        b = False
        if b:
            good.append(i + 1)
    
    if len(good) == 0:
        print("0")
    else:
        print(len(good))
        for idx in good:
            print(idx)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
